transcript.text: Hi, my Bosch WAN28281GB has stopped half way through a wash and is showing E18. Water still in the drum. What does that mean?

E18 on your Bosch means the machine has detected that it cannot drain the water from the drum within the expected time. This is almost always caused by a blockage in the pump filter or drain hose, rather than a broken part. To resolve this, please switch off and unplug the machine first. Then open the small access flap at the bottom front of the appliance (you may need a coin to release it). Place towels and a shallow tray underneath as water will spill out when you unscrew the filter. Check if the filter is clogged with debris like lint or coins, and clear it out. Let me know what you find.

Thanks, I unplugged it and emptied the water into a baking tray first, which took several trays. Then I unscrewed the filter and found a child's sock and a hair grip wrapped round it, plus a lot of fluff. A little water got onto the floor but nothing near the socket. What should I do next?

Please keep the machine unplugged. Shine a torch into the hole where the filter was and gently try to turn the small plastic fan blades inside with your finger. If it spins freely, you can reassemble everything and run a drain/spin cycle to test it. If it feels jammed or you find more debris caught in the vanes, clear that out as well.
I turned the fan blades by finger with it unplugged. It's a bit notchy at first, then turns freely. I'll put the filter back and run a drain/spin cycle now.

That notchy feeling when you turned the vanes suggests there may still be some small debris caught in the pump impeller or the sump hose behind it. If it completes successfully, the issue is resolved.
I put the filter back and ran the drain and spin programme. It drained quickly, the E18 has gone and it spun normally.

That is excellent news. To help prevent this happening again, I would recommend checking the filter every few months or if you notice the machine taking longer to drain. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

candidates: Blocked pump filter or drain hose (high)
